# vyos.blueprints.ipsec_policy_based

Policy-based site-to-site IPsec (docs blueprint "Policy-based Site-to-Site VPN IPsec between VyOS and Cisco")

- Configures one IKE group, one ESP group, a pre-shared key per peer and site-to-site peers whose tunnels are defined by traffic selectors (local and remote prefixes). Optionally adds a default route towards the WAN gateway.
- Uses vyos.vyos resource modules only (vyos_vpn_ipsec, vyos_vpn_ipsec_s2s, vyos_static_routes).
- The far end can be any IKE peer; match its proposals and mirror the traffic selectors there.
- WAN and LAN addressing belongs to `vyos.blueprints.base`.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.ipsec_policy_based
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers` | list | yes |  | Remote peers. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.name` | str | yes |  | Peer name, e.g. `CISCO`. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.local_address` | str | yes |  | Local WAN address used for IKE. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.remote_address` | str | yes |  | Peer's WAN address. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.local_id` | str |  |  | Local IKE id. Defaults to `local_address`. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.remote_id` | str |  |  | Remote IKE id. Defaults to `remote_address`. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.psk` | str | yes |  | Pre-shared key. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.psk_type` | str |  |  | Encoding of `psk`. Not set when omitted (VyOS default, plaintext). |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.psk_name` | str |  |  | Name of the PSK entry. Defaults to `<name>-PSK`. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.connection_type` | str |  | `initiate` | `initiate` brings the tunnels up from this side; `none` only responds. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.virtual_address` | str |  |  | Request a virtual IP from the peer, e.g. `0.0.0.0` for FlexVPN. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.authentication_ids` | bool |  | `true` | Set `local-id`/`remote-id` on the peer (the PSK ids are always set). |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.tunnels` | list | yes |  | Traffic selectors, one IPsec SA each. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.tunnels.id` | int |  |  | Tunnel number. Defaults to the position in the list (1, 2, ...). |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.tunnels.local_prefix` | str | yes |  | Local network, e.g. `192.168.0.0/24`. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.tunnels.remote_prefix` | str | yes |  | Remote network, e.g. `192.168.10.0/24`. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers.tunnels.protocol` | str |  |  | Protect only this protocol, e.g. `gre` for GRE over IPsec. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group` | dict |  |  | IKE (phase 1) settings shared by all peers. Settings without a default here are configured only when given. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.name` | str |  | `IKE-GROUP` | Group name. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.proposal_id` | int |  | `10` | Proposal number. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.key_exchange` | str |  | `ikev2` | IKE version. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.lifetime` | int |  |  | Lifetime in seconds. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.dh_group` | int |  | `14` | Diffie-Hellman group. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.encryption` | str |  | `aes256` | Encryption, e.g. `aes128`. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.hash` | str |  | `sha256` | Hash, e.g. `sha1`. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.close_action` | str |  |  | Action when the peer closes the SA. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.dead_peer_detection` | dict |  |  | DPD settings; only the keys given are configured. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.dead_peer_detection.action` | str |  |  | DPD action. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.dead_peer_detection.interval` | int |  |  | Interval in seconds. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_ike_group.dead_peer_detection.timeout` | int |  |  | Timeout in seconds. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_esp_group` | dict |  |  | ESP (phase 2) settings shared by all peers. Settings without a default here are configured only when given. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_esp_group.name` | str |  | `ESP-GROUP` | Group name. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_esp_group.proposal_id` | int |  | `10` | Proposal number. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_esp_group.mode` | str |  |  | ESP mode. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_esp_group.lifetime` | int |  |  | Lifetime in seconds. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_esp_group.pfs` | str |  |  | PFS group or `disable`. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_esp_group.encryption` | str |  | `aes256` | Encryption. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_esp_group.hash` | str |  | `sha256` | Hash. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Interfaces IPsec listens on (`vpn ipsec interface`), e.g. `[eth0]`. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_options` | dict |  | `{}` | `vpn ipsec options`, passed through as the `options` of vyos.vyos.vyos_vpn_ipsec. For FlexVPN, e.g. `{flexvpn: true, virtual_ip: true, interface: tun1, disable_route_autoinstall: true}`. |
| `ipsec_policy_based_default_gateway` | str |  | `''` | Adds `0.0.0.0/0` via this next hop (the WAN gateway). |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks the IPsec SA of every tunnel of every peer is up.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ipsec_policy_based_peers` | list | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
